name: Dynamic SQL Query Construction
description: Potential SQL injection: a dynamically constructed SQL statement is passed to a raw database method without a separate parameter list.
remediation: Use a constant SQL statement with placeholders and pass untrusted values through the method's parameter list.

name: Dynamic Process Execution
description: Potential command injection: a runtime-controlled executable or argument is passed to a Process execution method.
remediation: Use a fixed executable, apply a strict allow-list to every runtime-controlled argument, and never build shell command strings from untrusted input.

name: Unrestricted File Selection
description: FilePicker.pickFiles allows unrestricted file types. Unsafe files may reach upload, parsing, or storage logic without an allow-list.
remediation: Use FileType.custom with a strict allowedExtensions list, then validate file size, MIME type, content signature, and destination again before upload or processing.

name: Unvalidated Deep Link Flow
description: A deep-link value appears to reach a navigation or URL-opening sink without a recognized scheme, host, path, or parameter validation guard.
remediation: Parse the URI safely and validate its scheme, host, path, and accepted parameters against an allow-list before navigation or URL opening.

name: Missing TextFormField Validator
description: TextFormField is editable but has no validator callback. Input validation may be missing or implemented outside the widget.
remediation: Add a validator callback or document and enforce equivalent validation before the value reaches security-sensitive logic.
